user_question: At 25 °C and 1 atm, can 50 g of sodium bicarbonate, with acetic acid available in excess, generate at least 10 L of carbon dioxide? Determine the answer from authoritative sources and provide a reproducible quantitative justification.

open_ended_contract.authoritative_source_requirement: Use authoritative primary, governmental, standards, or high-quality scientific reference sources sufficient to support all consequential constants and chemistry claims.
open_ended_contract.reproducibility_requirement: Preserve source provenance and all consequential intermediate quantities so an independent verifier can reconstruct the answer.

independent_oracle.method: Independently inspect the producer-selected authoritative sources, verify every consequential chemistry claim and numeric value, independently recompute the limiting-reagent and gas-volume result without importing producer modules, and compare the final predicate and conclusion scope.

freeze_note: Scientific question, conditions, acceptance threshold, open-endedness requirements, execution constraints, and verification contract frozen before source/provider/tool discovery.
